1.summary: Week 1 ends tomorrow (Tue 24 Nov) and none of the 3 planned items has shipped: the n8n agent build (Wed) and the n8n loops Short (Sat) are still 'writing', and there is no record of whether Sunday's Skool clinic ran. No new video has been published since 21 Nov. The one bright spot is unplanned: the junior-dev J-Curve video went from 18 to 64 views in 2 days (about 32 a day), the fastest start of any recent upload. Publishing is steady, but the plan is not what is shipping.

checks.detail: 'Stuck in Red Tape?' has 11 views and 'Rider, Driver or Pilot?' 22 after about 2 days: narrow commentary and a mindset Short, the shapes that keep underperforming. The exception is the J-Curve long video, now at 64 views (32 a day) and the best ramp of the week; judge it at 7 days (28 Nov) against 'Become a Delivery Pilot' (135 after 14 days).

checks.detail: The J-Curve long video and the Rider/Driver Short went out on the same day, so they split the push YouTube gives each upload.
